domains.target: Cloudflare Pages public shell alias; static status page at /status.html

domains.purpose: Public-safe status, install, or identity helper paths

domains.target: GitHub Pages MkDocs deployment via Cloudflare DNS

bootstrap_steps: Publish the allowlisted public shell and installer to the heiwa-clients Cloudflare Pages project through deploy.yml.
Publish docs.heiwa.ltd through the GitHub Pages workflow using the locked MkDocs dependencies.
Verify status.heiwa.ltd/status.html after deployment; the alias serves the public shell and does not prove live runtime health.
Keep runtime control on each user's installed local heiwa runtime.
Keep api.heiwa.ltd paused until public-safe helper paths have their own acceptance evidence.
Keep canonical evidence in local JSONL journals; Lance remains derived and rebuildable.
Download binaries and checksums only from GitHub Releases; Cloudflare serves installer glue, not release binaries.
Verify published endpoints after deployment; this manifest records routing intent, not live health.
